==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I have been thinking about the elven zombies that are stuck in space. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (I placed the elven zombies in space in a previous dream earlier this month, so that they could thrive on Boltzmann brains without threatening the rest of the villagers.) The Elven Village has never fully recovered from their absence. (The streets of the Elven Village have been emptier than they used to be.) I am still trying to figure out how I want to help fill the gap left by those missing villagers.
